source_units.text: A horology club has shared diagrams of mechanical clock movements.
Plan my study of how the parts relate.
Cover these exact topic labels: "Anchor Escapements", "Balance Wheels", "Gear Trains".
Give each one at least 20 minutes over the whole plan.
A little variety in the ordering would be nice, but it is optional and adds no minimum-time requirements.
